exercise.name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction

reference.title: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction
reference.listing: Catalog entry only (gymvisual.com not read; blocked by the proxy). Movement from the exercise name and standard coaching.

equipment: Resistance band (mini loop above the knees)

breathing.pattern: Exhale as the knees press out, inhale as they return.
breathing.cadence: About 1 s out, 0.6 s hold, 1.8 s in

prescription.progression: Stronger band, or lean forward a little to bias the gluteus maximus

cues.text: Sit tall at the end of the bench, band above the knees, feet flat about hip width, hands resting on the thighs.
Breathe out and press both knees out against the band.
Pause wide; the feet stay put.
Breathe in and let the knees come back in slowly.
Keep tension in the band; repeat.

mistakes.fix: Keep the feet flat; the knees move, the feet stay.
Sit tall on the sit bones.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the band snap the knees in

kinematics.norm: About 25-35 degrees each side from the knees together (clinical opinion); seated and side-lying abduction load the gluteus medius (Macadam 2015)
Mini loop above both knees (elastic resistance, Andersen 2010)

sources.title: GymVisual #11511, Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction, video (movement reference)
Macadam, Cronin & Contreras 2015, gluteal muscle activity in dynamic hip abduction and hip external rotation exercise: a systematic review (Int J Sports Phys Ther 10(5):573-591; PMC4595911)

Andersen, Andersen, Mortensen, Poulsen, Bjørnlund and Zebis 2010, muscle activation and perceived loading during rehabilitation exercises: comparison of dumbbells and elastic resistance (Phys Ther 90(4):538-549)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness or cramping occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Check the band for nicks before use.

muscleNotes.glute_med_r: Abducts the flexed hip against the band (Macadam 2015).
muscleNotes.glute_med_l: Abducts the flexed hip against the band (Macadam 2015).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Upper fibres abduct and externally rotate the flexed hip (Selkowitz 2013; Macadam 2015).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Upper fibres abduct and externally rotate the flexed hip (Selkowitz 2013; Macadam 2015).
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Lengthen as the knees open (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Lengthen as the knees open (clinical opinion).
